purpose: Document separate English/Ukrainian discovery, local and national cadastral custody, anonymous request outcomes, safe field limits, and uncertainty.
assessment: Vinnytsia City Council's architecture and urban-planning department states that it organizes and maintains urban-cadastre and land-cadastre information. The regional StateGeoCadastre office and the national public cadastral-map documentation evidence the national cadastral custodian and public search route. No safe anonymous parcel geometry response was verified.
registryAssessment: Local registry/cadastre custody is evidenced by official Vinnytsia City Council pages and the regional StateGeoCadastre office. This is evidence of custodial responsibility and public procedures, not successful source integration.
